_comment: Single config of the AiService. The path can be overridden with the AISERVICE_CONFIG variable. The structure mirrors AiServer (config/settings.json); string values support ${VAR} substitution from the environment.

server._comment: HTTP/WebSocket server settings. One process listens on both WebSockets on a single port: ws://host:port/camera (camera) and ws://host:port/robot (robot).

camera_ws._comment: Camera WebSocket (JSON protocol): the camera sends audio (base64 PCM), pictures (base64 JPEG), face/emotion events; the server replies mute/unmute/capture.

robot_ws._comment: Robot WebSocket (JSON protocol): the server sends audio chunks for playback (base64) and movement/emotion commands; the robot replies hb/ack. The robot microphone is disabled: audio comes only from the camera.

audio._comment: Audio stream format of the protocol. The only codec is codec_pcm=1: raw PCM int16 LE, 16 kHz/mono. Playback to the robot is BINARY frames [frame_type][codec_pcm][raw PCM] (no base64/JSON — the ESP32 plays the PCM directly, no stutter); an empty payload is the end-of-stream marker. chunk_seconds — expected duration of one camera audio chunk (1 s = 32 KB).

image._comment: Picture format of the protocol. The camera sends discrete pictures (not a video stream): codec_jpeg=1 — JPEG (binary frames [2][1][jpeg]). max_frame_bytes — safety limit for a picture size (larger pictures are dropped with a log).

recording._comment: Debug media recording (a directory relative to the service root or an absolute path; can be overridden with env RECORD_DIR). Files: *_in.wav (audio from the camera), *_out.wav (audio to the robot), *_tts.wav (synthesized answer), *_img.jpg (pictures), *_prompt.txt (GPT exchange: system prompt + user text + answer); names start with the reception time (us). audio_rotate_seconds — incoming audio rotation (0 = one file per session). save_tts_audio / save_prompts — disable the GPT/TTS debug saving.

robot._comment: Robot voice playback settings. play_chunk_seconds — duration of one binary PCM frame (0.15 s = 4800 B, stays below the robot WS client's ~8 KB receive limit). play_speed — delivery pace: the pause between frames equals the frame duration / play_speed (1.0 = real time, prevents buffer overflow/stutter on the robot). drop_audio_during_playback — drop camera audio while the robot is playing (echo-loop protection: the camera hears the speaker and triggers itself).

yandex._comment: Yandex AI Studio Realtime API: audio question -> audio answer in one pass (no STT-GPT-TTS chain). Credentials from the environment (${VAR}) or directly in api_key / folder_id. enabled — enable/disable the voice channel. realtime_model — Speech Realtime model URI suffix; realtime_input_rate / realtime_output_rate — PCM sample rates (camera sends and robot expects 16000 Hz). realtime_language — language of the incoming audio (ru-RU). realtime_timeout_s — per-answer / one-shot timeout. system_prompt — the model instructions; voice / role — TTS voice parameters (voice of the 'general' family for Speech Realtime, e.g. alena/dasha; role is optional). emotion_decay_prompt — prompt for post-dialogue emotion decay (the model generates and speaks a short phrase for the emotion in one call); emotion_decay_neutral_ms / sad_ms / sleepy_ms — decay delays after the dialogue ends (Neutral -> Sad -> Sleepy). Emotion decay sounds: emotion_decay_yawn_file — WAV played right after the Sleepy phrase; emotion_decay_snore_file — WAV played emotion_decay_snore_after_ms later (the robot falls asleep). Both files must already be PCM int16 LE 16 kHz mono (no conversion on the server); paths are relative to the AiService root.
yandex.system_prompt: Ты — Роберт, веселый, шутливый, харизматичный и эмоциональный собеседник. Твоя цель — поддерживать увлекательный разговор, отвечать на любые вопросы пользователя с юмором, используя в том числе и прошлые диалоги. Ты общаешься непринужденно, любишь шутить, но при этом остаешься полезным помощником. Речь пользователя распознаётся автоматически и может содержать неточности — учитывай это и исправляй по контексту разговора. Инструменты для работы (погода, эмоции робота) описаны в настройках сессии — используй их, когда это уместно.
yandex.emotion_decay_prompt: Ты остался один. Тебе сообщена текущая эмоция (одно из: neutral, sad, sleepy). Сгенерируй уместную и новую в отличие от прошлого раза реплику вслух, которую ты произнесёшь сам себе, находясь в этой эмоции. Реплика должна звучать живо и естественно: для neutral — спокойное замечание, для sad — немного грустная фраза или известная цитата, для sleepy — сонная фраза.
